lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ح/م/د   ḥ–m–d praise, praiseworthy, to commend, to find to be praiseworthy.

Of this root, 7 forms occur 68 times in the Qur’an:
يُحْمَدُوا yuḥmadū 1 time; حَمْدٌ ḥamd 43 times; حاَمِدُون ḥāmidūn 1 time; مَحْمُودٌ maḥmūd 1 time; حَمِيدٌ ḥamıd 17 times; أَحْمَدُ ʾaḥmad 1 time and مُحَمَّدٌ Muḥammad 4 times.

entries.label: أَحْمَدُ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَحْمَدُ ʾaḥmad [elat.; proper name] most praiseworthy; one of the names of the Prophet Muḥammad

(61:6) وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ and bringing good news of a messenger to follow me whose name will be ʾaḥmad.

entries.label: حَامِدُون
entries.definitionHtml:
حَامِدُون ḥāmidūn [pl. of act. part. حَامِدٌ ḥāmid] those who praise

(9:112) التَّائِبُونَ الْعَابِدُونَ الْحَامِدُونَ those who repent, those who worship, those who praise Him.

entries.label: حَمِيدٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
حَمِيدٌ ḥamıd [quasi‐pass./act part.] worthy of great praise, an attribute of God

(31:12) فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٌ God is All‐sufficient, worthy of all praise.

entries.label: مَحْمُودٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مَحْمُودٌ maḥmūd [pass. part.] praised, exalted, praiseworthy

(17:79) عَسَى أَنْ يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا it may be that your Lord may elevate you to a [highly] praised status.

entries.label: مُحَمَّدٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
مُحَمَّدٌ Muḥammad [intens. pass. part.; proper name] one worthy of much and constant praise; name of the Prophet

entries.label: يُحْمَدُ
entries.definitionHtml:
يُحْمَدُ yuḥmad [imperf. of pass. v. حُمِدَ ḥumida] to be praised, to be commended
